mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1250 and RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing expansion regime (INDPRO > 105), rising industrial production signals strong output growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105.

mechanism_narrative: A positive GDP growth rate (computed from GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals strong economic conditions and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 149000 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 1250), rising housing starts signal strong consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1250.
